# Google Vertex AI -> Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform — captured 2026-08-07

## SOURCE STATUS
- sources.json still points at cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/release-notes. It 301s to
  docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/release-notes and that page now carries ONLY Agent Platform
  Workbench image bumps + a Colab Enterprise CVE note (Jul 6 / Jul 13, 2026). It is no longer the
  agent-platform changelog. RECOMMENDATION (unactioned since 2026-07-08): repoint to
  https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/release-notes
- That canonical RN page renders nav-only via WebFetch (recurring). Dated rows recovered via WebSearch
  and corroborated against the product docs.

## August 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- **AlphaEvolve optimization service — GA** on the Gemini Enterprise agent. Code optimization and
  discovery agent: from a baseline seed algorithm, Gemini models generate mutated candidate programs;
  the customer's EVALUATOR RUNS CLIENT-SIDE on their own infrastructure and submits scores back;
  iterates until convergence on optimized human-readable code.
  Docs: /gemini/enterprise/docs/alphaevolve/developer-guide/overview
- Gemini 3.5 Flash removed from the global region in the Gemini Enterprise app (Aug 4). [deprecation]
- Grok 4.1 family (xai/grok-4.1-fast-reasoning, xai/grok-4.1-fast-non-reasoning) deprecated, shutdown
  Aug 20. [deprecation]

## July 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- **Memory Bank — Memory Profiles GA**: structured profiles with static, user-defined schemas
  populated/updated by LLMs via GenerateMemories and IngestEvents; low-latency in-session access
  without search. Docs: /gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/scale/memory-bank/profiles
  (Memory Bank + Sessions multi-regional and global endpoints also GA.)
- **Feedback service (Preview)**: collect, analyze and manage end-user qualitative feedback
  (thumbs up/down sentiment, feedback labels) from agent-user interactions.
- **User ID logging**: prompt-input / response-output agent logs now include the `user.id` field when
  "Enable logging of prompt inputs and response outputs" is on.
- SSRF fix in the Agent Studio auto-generated /api-proxy backend endpoint for web apps created before
  Jul 1, 2026 (stricter domain allowlist). [security fix, not a new capability — below bar]

## June 2026 [already cached — reported 2026-07-08]
- Agent Registry GA; Agent Observability + default OTel tracing GA; AI Security Findings / posture
  dashboard GA; Model Armor on Agent Gateway GA.

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Secondary tier. Three reportable additions (AlphaEvolve GA, Memory Profiles GA,
Feedback service + user.id logging).
